floater.name: ks_lighting_quick
floater.title: Quick

button.label: My Environments...
button.name: ks_open_my_env
button.tool_tip: Opens My Environments: your sky, water and day cycle items.

button.label: Use Shared
button.name: ks_use_shared
button.tool_tip: Use Shared Environment: drops your local sky and water. Also turns Use KS Reference off.

check_box.label: Dynamic exposure
check_box.name: ks_dynamic_exposure
check_box.tool_tip: Adapts exposure to scene brightness. Off and disabled while Use KS Reference is on. (KS Reference) No effect while Build > Options > No Post-processing is on and the Build floater is open.

check_box.label: Use KS Reference
check_box.name: ks_use_ks
check_box.tool_tip: Sets the KStorm reference values: Sky HDR Scale 0.1 (pins auto-exposure), Probe Fill Strength 0.01, Haze Density 0.1, sun and fill light, and Dynamic exposure off. Turning it off restores your values.

slider.label: Exposure
slider.name: ks_exposure
slider.tool_tip: Overall scene exposure. No effect while Build > Options > No Post-processing is on and the Build floater is open.

slider.label: Sunlight Scale
slider.name: ks_sunlight_scale
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of direct sun and moon light.

slider.label: Haze Density
slider.name: sky_haze_density
slider.tool_tip: At 0, Haze Glow Strength, Haze Glow Focus and Haze Glow Brightness stop working, fog takes Air Glow Color only, and distance fog depends on Air Density's red channel. (KS Reference)

slider.label: Sky HDR Scale
slider.name: sky_gamma
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of sky and haze relative to the scene; also sets how far auto-exposure can adjust. At 0.25 or below, auto-exposure is fixed at 1. (KS Reference)

button.label: Settings...
button.name: ks_ao_settings
button.tool_tip: Opens the Ambient pane (ambient light and ambient occlusion).

slider.label: Ambient Brightness
slider.name: sky_ambient_brightness
slider.tool_tip: Brightness of sky fill light. Its color comes from the sky; surfaces use brightness only. At Probe Fill Strength 1 or more this no longer lights surfaces. (KS Reference)

slider.label: Probe Fill Strength
slider.name: sky_probe_fill
slider.tool_tip: Low: fill from sky ambient (uniform). High: fill from probes (bounce light, darker interiors). Reflections are unaffected. On a legacy sky, editing makes the local copy an EEP sky. (KS Reference)

text.name: ks_note_pinned_row
text.tool_tip: Auto-exposure is fixed at 1 because Sky HDR Scale is 0.25 or less.

floater.text: Auto-exposure pinned at 1 (Sky HDR Scale 0.25 or less).
